title: SNT release manifest
description: release_manifest.json, attached as an asset to a GitHub release: every file the release ships, with its sha256, and which of those files ship inside which OpenHEXA pipeline version zip. Produced by the 'Generate Release Manifest' workflow (.github/workflows/generate_manifest.yaml) of the source repository; consumed by snt_workspace_deployer (split_manifest, download_manifest) and snt_workspace_checker (load_manifests, build_index). Derived from that code, not from prose (PRODUCT_SPEC.md section 2.1, decision D26). Repository-agnostic: it fixes the shape, not which paths a given repository ships - for snt_development those are its R notebooks and helpers plus every top-level directory holding a pipeline.py. The manifest carries no schema_version key; adding one is a change to the producer. Compatibility rules, as for status_report.schema.json: adding a key is NOT a breaking change; renaming or removing a key, changing a type, or changing what a value means is breaking. This schema is deliberately strict (additionalProperties: false) so a producer cannot drift silently; a CONSUMER must instead ignore unknown keys. Two invariants hold but cannot be expressed in JSON Schema, so a validator must check them separately: (1) for every pipeline directory D and every entry M of its zip_files, the path 'D/M' is a key of files; (2) every zip_files list contains 'pipeline.py'. Pre-phase-0 manifests (development-only releases before 2026-09-21: version and files only, no pipelines block) do NOT validate and are not supported (D26): snt_workspace_checker and snt_workspace_deployer both refuse them.

version.description: The release tag this manifest describes (the workflow's GITHUB_REF_NAME), e.g. v0.2.1-test. On a manual workflow_dispatch run it is the branch name instead, or 'unknown' if unset. No consumer reads it today: both pipelines identify a release by its GitHub tag_name, never by this field.

files.description: Every tracked file, flat across both delivery routes: {repository path: sha256}. A path is a filesystem file (synced into the workspace by snt_workspace_deployer) unless its first segment is a key of pipelines, in which case it ships only inside that pipeline's version zip.

pipelines.description: {repository directory: pipeline spec}, one entry per deployable OpenHEXA pipeline. The key is a single top-level directory, not a nested path: snt_workspace_deployer excludes a file from the filesystem sync by its first path segment alone. May be empty for a release that ships no pipeline, but must be present.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex sha256 of the file's bytes, as hashlib.hexdigest() writes it.

relative_path.description: A POSIX path relative to the repository root (or, in zip_files, to the pipeline directory): no leading slash, no '.' or '..' segment, no empty segment, no backslash.

directory_name.description: One path segment: a top-level directory of the repository.

code.description: The OpenHEXA pipeline code: the directory name with underscores replaced by hyphens (snt_map_extracts -> snt-map-extracts). The only place a consumer can get it from.

zip_files.description: Paths as they appear inside the pipeline's version zip, i.e. relative to the pipeline directory, so they compare directly against the zip's namelist(). Prefix one with the directory key and '/' to get the key into files, and so the expected hash.
